# azureacme_namespace (Data Source)

What one namespace permits: domains, destinations, wildcard policy, key policies and the caller's roles. Use it in a `lifecycle { precondition }` so an authorisation mistake fails the plan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Move authorisation failures from APPLY time to PLAN time.
#
# Without a precondition, the only feedback channel for an unapproved domain, a
# forbidden wildcard or a non-permitted destination is a 403 after
# `terraform apply` has already begun changing other resources.

data "azureacme_namespace" "payments" {
  name = "payments-prod"
}

output "permitted_destinations" {
  value = [for d in data.azureacme_namespace.payments.permitted_destinations : d.key_vault_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allowed_deletion_policies` (List of String)
- `allowed_key_policies` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allowed_key_policies))
- `caller_roles` (List of String)
- `default_deletion_policy` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `max_identifiers_per_certificate` (Number)
- `permitted_destinations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permitted_destinations))
- `permitted_domains` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permitted_domains))
- `policy_revision` (Number)
- `wildcard_policy_json` (String) The wildcard policy document, verbatim as JSON. Wildcard is its own axis and is NEVER inferred from a name-scope grant.

<a id="nestedatt--allowed_key_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allowed_key_policies`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String)
- `curves` (List of String)
- `sizes` (List of Number)


<a id="nestedatt--permitted_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permitted_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `certificate_name_allow` (List of String)
- `destination_id` (String)
- `key_vault_id` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--permitted_domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permitted_domains`

Read-Only:

- `base` (String)
- `effect` (String)
- `kind` (String) `exact`, `subtree` or `wildcard`. **`subtree` does not match its own base**: authorising `api.example.com` itself requires an `exact` rule.
- `max_labels_below` (Number)
